description: Consolidated Edison, Inc., incorporated in New York State in 1997, is a holding company that owns all of the outstanding common stock of Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc., Orange and Rockland Utilities, Inc. and Con Edison Transmission, Inc. Its principal business operations are those of CECONY, whose principal business operations are its regulated electric, gas and steam delivery businesses; Orange and Rockland Utilities, whose principal business operations are its regulated electric and gas delivery businesses; and Con Edison Transmission, which through its subsidiaries develops and invests in electric transmission projects and owns, through joint ventures, both electric and gas assets. Con Edison seeks to provide shareholder value through continued dividend growth, supported by earnings growth.
